description: Deletes a song from the calling account's notebook. Idempotent: deleting twice succeeds twice, and an unknown id succeeds too (saying "no such song" would leak whether it exists in someone else's notebook). Side effects are the same as deleting in the app: the song leaves all its playlists, its published copy disappears from the profile, and accounts that had imported it are notified. This cannot be undone from the API: confirm with the person before calling it.
name: jj_delete_song
title: Delete a notebook song
